body:
Part of #36. Plan step **P02**. Related historical work: #26 R1/R2; its closed issue state does not establish financial correctness.

Blocked by: #38. These are completion dependencies; synthetic groundwork exceptions are stated below.

## Outcome

Establish source meaning for a bounded monthly product-profit population using independent evidence from an explicitly authorized isolated restored backup. Keep the source permanently read-only. This issue delivers an evidenced mapping contract, not an owner UI.

## Work

- [ ] Verify the exact authorized source/scope, lineage, engine/schema, backup identity when available, source cutoff and retained private evidence. If renewed inspection lacks authorization or evidence is unavailable, continue synthetic preparation and keep real-source gates open.
- [ ] Apply P01 (#38)'s reviewed column/query scope. Verify restricted reader permissions and fail-closed projections; no broad table replication or additions to the raw preview by implication.
- [ ] Resolve completed sales, type-11/type-35 economic identity, returns, voids/deletions and converted documents. Prove the joins and stable product/line/document identities without multiplying rows.
- [ ] Validate business dates, TRY classification, quantity units/multipliers, net/gross/KDV basis, discount allocation and rounding. Classify unsupported/non-TRY populations and their dependency impact explicitly.
- [ ] Validate transaction-time historical cost units/tax basis and original-sale return-cost attribution. Fetch approved dependency evidence outside the month when required; do not assume the bounded window contains it. Missing, undocumented zero, negative and contradictory costs remain separate exclusions.
- [ ] Create a rule-by-rule mapping/evidence matrix with included/excluded counts and monetary exposure where measurable. Use independent decimal expectations and representative sale/return/discount/unit examples. Raw SUM equality proves transport only, not financial interpretation.
- [ ] Update `docs/contracts/source.md`, `calculations.md`, `privacy.md` and `src/source/contract.ts` only for demonstrated rules. If some rules stay unsupported, record exactly which metric/population remains blocked; never promote a whole month because one sample matches.

## Reuse and proof

Read [docs/contracts/source.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/contracts/source.md), [docs/evidence/issue-26-source-validation.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/evidence/issue-26-source-validation.md) and [docs/evidence/real-sql-preview.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/evidence/real-sql-preview.md). Reuse `tools/collect-source-evidence.ts`, `src/source/sql-server.ts`, `tests/integration/source-evidence.test.ts` and `tests/integration/source-readonly.test.ts` where their scopes fit. These existing allowlists are not authorization to inspect extra fields.

Private rows, credentials, source locators and exact-value evidence stay outside Git/logs/screenshots. Public examples must be synthetic or separately approved reduced fixtures.

## Exit gate

Every enabled rule has traceable source evidence and an independent expected result; unresolved cases have enforced capability limits. A01/A02/A03/A05 contributions are recorded without claiming full-volume or Windows acceptance. If evidence is insufficient, deliver the blockers and keep real financial activation blocked.

## Execution and evidence

This is a planning backlog, not an instruction to start implementation. First settle the named decisions in P01 (#38) with the user. For each behavioral change, expose the missing contract with a focused failing test, record the actual failure, make the smallest implementation change, and run the relevant checks. Reuse the existing Vitest, Playwright packaged-desktop and synthetic SQL harness; do not create a new orchestration framework.

Use coherent Conventional Commits (`test:`, `feat:`/`fix:`, then evidence as needed). Record the task/gate, commit/build, opaque fixture/source batch, environment, command/procedure, expected and actual result, evidence location and remaining limits. Synthetic success is not source validation; macOS success is not Windows acceptance. Preserve unrelated work and accepted reports. Source access and production rollout retain their separate authorization boundaries.
title: [P1] Validate SQL sales and historical cost evidence for product profit
